rules.content:
title: Multilingual Chatbot Scam Pattern Detection
status: experimental
description: Detect messaging patterns consistent with AI chatbot-initiated scam contact: (1) unusually consistent response timing with less than 2 second variance indicating automated replies, (2) scripted conver
logsource:
    product: messaging_platform
    category: conversation_analytics
    service: abuse_detection
detection:
    selection_timing:
        response_time_variance_ms|lt: 2000
        message_count|gte: 10
    selection_template:
        conversation_template_match_score|gt: 0.8
    selection_language_switch:
        language_switch_count|gte: 1
        conversation_languages_count|gte: 2
    selection_duplicate_phrasing:
        cross_instance_phrase_similarity|gt: 0.9
        reported_instances|gte: 2
    condition: selection_timing and (selection_template or selection_language_switch or selection_duplicate_phrasing)
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0117: Multilingual Chatbot Scam Pattern Detection (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Crypto Rug Pull On-Chain Indicators")`
index=blockchain sourcetype=defi:events
| eval risk_score = case(
    liquidity_removal_pct > 80, 10,
    top5_holder_pct > 0.60, 7,
    has_hidden_mint = "true", 8,
    has_hidden_pause = "true", 6,
    liquidity_unlocked = "true", 5,
    1=1, 0
  )
| where risk_score >= 7
| table _time, token_address, token_name, risk_score,
        liquidity_removal_pct, top5_holder_pct,
        has_hidden_mint, has_hidden_pause, liquidity_unlocked
rules.title: DL-0142: Crypto Token Rug Pull Early Warning — On-Chain and OSINT Indicators (SPLUNK)
